items.series: T-PLUS P1 What if, on the clock
items.hypothesis: TP-B1 P1: MODEL on the T+ clock; primary = public views at 48 h.
items.caption:
If the Moon vanished, you'd still see it for 1.3 seconds.
Then the biggest tides shrink to about a third (estimate), and over millions of years Earth's tilt could wander up to 85° (NASA, NOAA, Laskar et al. 1993). A thought experiment.
